crossRefs.note: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction…
Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
Yahweh, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.
The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.
“Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls…
About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”
So I bought a belt according to Yahweh’s word, and put it on my waist.
“Therefore I will scatter them, as the stubble that passes away, by the wind of the wilderness.
I will make them to pass with your enemies into a land which you don’t know; for a fire is kindled in my anger, which…

people.name: Dan
people.line: Fifth son of Jacob, founder of Israelite tribe

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.
translations.bsb: Then Rachel said, “God has vindicated me; He has heard my plea and given me a son.” So she named him Dan.
translations.kjv: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
translations.asv: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
